description: Source code defining the 'Object' and 'BusObject' interfaces for D-Bus communication, including methods for method calls, property access, and signal matching.

classes.name: BusObject
classes.description: Interface representing a remote D-Bus object with methods for invocation, property management, and signal handling.

classes.name: Object
classes.description: Struct representing a remote D-Bus object with methods for method invocation, property access, and signal subscription.

methods.name: Call
methods.description: Calls a method on the object and waits for its reply.

methods.name: CallWithContext
methods.description: Calls a method with a specified context and waits for its reply.

methods.name: AddMatchSignal
methods.description: Subscribes to signals from a specified interface and member.

methods.name: RemoveMatchSignal
methods.description: Unsubscribes from signals from a specified interface and member.

methods.name: Go
methods.description: Calls a method asynchronously and returns a Call structure.

methods.name: GoWithContext
methods.description: Calls a method asynchronously with a specified context.

methods.name: createCall
methods.description: Internal method to create and send a method call message.

methods.name: GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the remote object.

methods.name: StoreProperty
methods.description: Stores a property value retrieved from the remote object.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value on the remote object.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Returns the destination address of the object.
